# External Supporting Data

This directory is reserved for approved supporting datasets that are not part of the primary raw fisheries, chlorophyll-a, or SST sources.

No additional environmental dataset is currently mandatory or approved for Component 3. Rainfall, monsoon mappings, boundaries, or other supporting sources may be added later only when their research purpose, source, licence, spatial coverage, and temporal coverage are documented.

External data files must remain outside Git unless redistribution is permitted and the file is appropriately small.
